items.summary: Toronto police investigators have identified a suspect after a man was fatally stabbed on a TTC bus in Scarborough on Thursday night. Nicholas Crawford, 40, of Toronto, is wanted for second-degree murder.

items.title: British police link substance release at Don Toliver's recent Manchester concert to robbery attempts
items.summary: British police said on Friday that the release of an unknown substance during a concert by rapper Don Toliver in Manchester earlier this week is linked to attempts to commit robberies on the night of the event.

items.summary: We speak to the EU's Commissioner for Defence and Space, Andrius Kubilius. The former prime minister of Lithuania – who grew up during the Soviet era – tells us how he sees the confrontation between Europe and Russia.

items.title: UN peacekeepers are preparing to leave southern Lebanon. There’s no plan for what comes next
items.summary: Among the few buildings still standing in the Lebanese border town of Naqoura are an abandoned hotel occupied by Israeli soldiers, its walls draped with anti-drone netting, and the compound housing the headquarters of the UN peacekeeping force.

items.title: Man sought for allegedly stealing poppy donation boxes
